nodes.label: Role-Split Refactor (scoped inventory)
nodes.rationale: Scoping only, no code; re-entry when the platform-role/body-label split is prioritised; exists so the refactor is scoped not discovered mid-flight (the exact underestimate that made the Sprint 3a role-widen cost real review effort).

nodes.label: Platform-role enum vs body-specific labels
nodes.rationale: A hardwired platform-role enum (maps to RLS) separate from configurable body-specific role labels; a new body's vocabulary becomes mapping rows, not a migration.

nodes.label: Three role-resolution indirection points
nodes.rationale: is_manager(), is_eventar_staff(), require_active_staff(); the blast radius is real but partially pre-consolidated - most sites already route through these three choke points, so the refactor extends them rather than rewriting dozens of scattered comparisons.

nodes.label: Definer functions passing raw role literals
nodes.rationale: transition_dsr, mark_attended, publish_event, verify_licence, lapse_licence, revoke_licence pass literal args to require_active_staff; pseudonymise_user has an inline check; args become platform-role enum values with body labels resolved before the call.
